name: Jingtao Yao
evidence: Anchored on the exact arXiv paper in via (2604.06210, 'Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook'). One WebSearch on the title plus the two co-author names, then the paper's own title page was read via the alphaXiv PDF tool (arXiv:2604.06210v4). The full author list printed there is: Jaehyeok Lee, Xiaoyuan Yi, Jing Yao, Hyunjin Hwang, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Xing Xie, JinYeong Bak - there is NO 'Jingtao Yao' on the paper. The nearest name is 'Jing Yao' (Microsoft Research Asia), a different name, so the namesake rule blocks treating that person as this row. Separately, the title page prints only three addresses and none belongs to any Yao: 'Correspondence to: Xiaoyuan Yi <xiaoyuanyi@microsoft.com>, JinYeong Bak <jy.bak@skku.edu>, contact: Jaehyeok Lee <hjl8708@skku.edu>'. So even under the charitable reading there is no address for this row. Not found.
